fusions.name: Seine the Shallows
fusions.desc: Drags a conjured seine through a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Darting Mesh
fusions.desc: Flicks a small mesh that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then slips on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Haul the Shoal
fusions.desc: Hauls up to 6 enemies within 6 tiles onto you in one sweep of your mesh and holds their attention for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wriggle Room
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 12% against enemies carrying one of your conditions.
